adaptation: TypeScript -> ESM JavaScript. The hashing, manifest sorting, integrityRoot, structured-claim extraction, claim statuses and decision rule are unchanged.

The donor's runtime types (`BossTask`, `ClaimRecord`, `CouncilSession`, `DisputeRecord`, `EvidenceBundle`, `RawArtifact`) are replaced by plain value shapes in `contracts.mjs`: EvidenceTask, EvidenceArtifact, EvidenceClaim, EvidenceDispute, EvidenceBundle. Nothing here needs a task runtime, provider automation, a council process or root trust.
`src/shared/contracts.ts` and `src/shared/provider-contracts.ts` are reference types only; no field of the Boss runtime was copied.

Every otherwise non-deterministic input is injectable: `idFactory` (default `crypto.randomUUID`), `now`, and `hash`. The same artifacts therefore always produce the same manifest, the same integrityRoot and the same bundle.

A resolved dispute no longer marks a claim DISPUTED: the donor had no resolution concept, and carrying a flag that changed nothing would be worse than either. An unresolved dispute still marks and still blocks.
`buildRehydrationPrompts` keeps the donor's prompt shape. It builds text; this module contacts nobody.
`describeBundle` and a `reasons` list make the decision explainable without re-deriving it from the claims.
knownDifferences: No task runtime, no provider automation, no council runtime, no research conductor and no root trust: those are explicitly out of scope.
No persistence and no network: the module is pure, and the incubator surface held its sample in the page only.
No provider call is ever made, so rehydration is a prompt document rather than a request.
No claim verification against the outside world: REFERENCED_NOT_VERIFIED means the declared evidence labels resolve, not that the claim is true.

vectors: artifact SHA-256 is computed over UTF-8 content and recorded at capture
a stored hash that no longer matches the content raises ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH and is never re-hashed
the manifest is sorted by artifact id and carries provider, kind, hash, bytes and capture time
the integrityRoot is the SHA-256 of the sorted manifest's `id:hash` lines, and is order-independent
artifacts belonging to another task are excluded from the manifest
structured claims are read from the `{"claims"` block; a missing or unparsable block yields no claims
Proposal A/B/C labels map to proposal artifact ids in artifact-id order
claim statuses: DISPUTED beats a resolved reference; a missing label is INSUFFICIENT; no labels is INSUFFICIENT
a synthesis with no structured block becomes one INSUFFICIENT claim naming the missing block
with no synthesis, proposals and responses become UNVERIFIED claims, recorded but not treated as evidence
PASS requires no missing provider, no unresolved dispute and no DISPUTED or INSUFFICIENT claim
task completion is never evidence: the decision is derived from the claim and dispute state
rehydration addresses only the unresolved claims and quotes only their artifacts
the bundle is deterministic when ids and the clock are injected
